summary: Iteration 6 e2e testing PASSED. Backend: 26/26 pytest tests passing (16 prior + 4 new-intent + 3 TTS tests added). All 4 new intents (action:meet_team, action:tour_visit, action:symptom_check, action:find_care) correctly returned by Claude. POST /api/assistant/tts returns audio_base64 ~58k+ bytes with mime audio/mpeg. Frontend: Home testimonials section renders 3 cards (Sarah J., Robert M., Elena R.) with 5-star ratings. /ai welcome view shows all 6 expected suggestion chips. Mic button toggles listening class. Sending each of the 4 trigger phrases transitions the left panel to the correct view: TeamCards (4 flip cards), TourCards (5 steps), BodyDiagram (7 regions), FindCare (6 option cards). Service detail (skilled nursing) renders SVG line-art illustration + testimonial callout (11 SVGs in dynamic view). 'Listen' TTS button on assistant messages successfully POSTs to /api/assistant/tts. Appointment form submission triggers canvas-confetti (canvas appears) AND personalized Sonner toast 'Thank you, Jane! We'll reach out within one business day.'. Mode toggle still present and working.

issues: Preferred date input uses browser's native date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn Calendar component used elsewhere in the design system. Inconsistent with brand polish.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Replace native <input type=date> in dyn-appointment-form with shadcn Calendar/DatePicker for visual consistency with the rest of the dark-mode design.

(Optional/minor) BodyDiagram renders 7 console errors: '<circle> attribute r: Expected length, "undefined"' on initial mount. Caused by framer-motion's first animate frame on motion.circle when no prior r value exists. Fix by either (a) supplying initial={{ r: r.r }} on motion.circle, or (b) animating only when isHover changes. Visual is fine; cleans up console noise.
(Carryover from iter 5) AIExperience.jsx mounts two ChatPanel instances (desktop aside + mobile stacked) — both fire GET /api/assistant/history on mount.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend TTS endpoint (server.py:356-372) is well-bounded: trims/limits text to 2000 chars, requires non-empty body (returns 400), validates EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (returns 500), wraps OpenAITextToSpeech failures as 502 — clean error contract.

VALID_INTENTS expanded to include all 4 new action intents and SYSTEM_PROMPT was updated with explicit routing rules for each — verified end-to-end (Claude returned exact expected intent string for each test phrase).
ChatPanel.jsx mic implementation gracefully alerts when SpeechRecognition is unavailable (line 82-85) and properly cleans up via onend/onerror (lines 102-103).
celebrate() helper in /app/frontend/src/lib/confetti.js correctly triggers canvas-confetti — verified canvas DOM node appears and personalized toast renders user's first name.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (added TestNewIntents parametrized tests for 4 new intents + TestTTS class with 3 tests)
seed_data_creation: Test docs created in MongoDB collections (contacts, referrals, surveys, appointments, chat_messages) prefixed with TEST_ via pytest run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter 6 features verified end-to-end. New intent routing confirmed: Claude consistently returns action:meet_team / action:tour_visit / action:symptom_check / action:find_care for the canonical phrases. TTS returns ~58k base64 in ~3s. Confetti renders <canvas> on form submit. Personalized toast extracts user's first name correctly via name.split(' ')[0]. Only minor cosmetic items remain: native date picker vs shadcn Calendar, and 7 framer-motion console warnings on BodyDiagram mount — neither blocks functionality.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found in iter 6 features.
